title: Does my first Game (as a hobby) have a future?
author: No-Second-4467
selftext: Hi everyone. I'm creating my first game as a hobby, but I've grown so fond of the idea that I'm dedicating a lot of time to it. I'd love to get some honest feedback. Do you think it has a solid enough foundation for me to keep working on it solo in my spare time until I can publish it on Steam?

comments.author: RepulsiveRaisin7
comments.body: Maybe? Combat looks rough, not sure about the rest. The survival genre is crowded but people do seem to like them. I think you'd need to put a lot more work into this to make it a success. Find a unique angle that isn't just a rehash of all the other games.

replies.author: No-Second-4467
replies.body: Valeu pelas dicas! Obrigado pelo comentário.

comments.author: Novaworld7
comments.body: Looks great man! Just compare it to some older games that were hits. I was reminded a bit of early Zelda on the gameboy. It only fails when you give up on it.

replies.author: No-Second-4467
replies.body: Obrigado pelo comentário u/Novaworld7, me deixou muito feliz.

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: all games do just be sure to learn marketing and go beyond ... plus ultra in your endeavors ... the aveage ai coder does very little and call it much.

comments.author: Bluetails_Buizel
comments.body: Welp, you used a template the ai gave you. Looks like this is your first time making a game it seems

replies.author: No-Second-4467
replies.body: Exatamente. Mas pedi alguns ajustes, tentei fazer no mesmo padrão, dei uma imagem de referência, etc...

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: You can try a 3D route, hire an artist, or actually pick up a pencil…

replies.author: No-Second-4467
replies.body: Valeu pelas dicas, mas errou em algo, não usei o Claude, usei o GPT Astra, rsrs

comments.author: StarMonkeyGames
comments.body:
it depends how much work you put into getting your game scene. You can't just make a good game and pray to the gods it finds it's audience. 

I'd argue marketing is now the harder part of game dev.

But there is no harm in publishing games besides like a hundred or so upfront cost? Maybe 200? I forget what steam charges for a page.

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: The art style is good, so it depends how good you're at making gameplay and a story.

comments.author: OutsideProperty382
comments.body: Looks decent. People would probably pay for it.

replies.author: No-Second-4467
replies.body: Fico feliz em ouvir isso u/OutsideProperty382
